rows.grounds: locative absolute participle indicating a completed action or occurrence
compound referring to the fault mentioned in context
purpose compound indicating the aim of appeasing the fault
ritual fire offering performed for pacification
temporal adverb indicating the time for the remedial action
prescriptive optative enjoining the remedial ritual

items.question: What ritual remedy must be performed to appease a fault that has occurred?
premises: A fault has occurred in the ritual context.
A peace-offering serves as the means of pacification.
items.inference: Therefore, when a fault has occurred, one should then perform a peace-offering for its pacification.
uncertainties: The specific nature of taddoṣa depends on the preceding ritual context.
items.plain_english: When that fault has occurred, one should then perform a peace-offering for its pacification.
